descriptionHtml: Power system simulation is a two-day workshop on power system simulation with hands on experience to all the participants is  had been conducted via zoom. All the participants were provided with a certificate of participation. The workshop was done using OpenDSS which is an open source software. Prof. Janaka Ekanayake had given an introductory speech to the session explaining various methods of power system simulating methods. The majority of the event were conducted by Mr. Eshan Karunaratne with the simulation part of the workshop.
